description: This file defines the Catalyst controller 'MealsDishesEditor' for handling AJAX requests related to meal and dish management within a project. It includes methods for retrieving project plans, moving meals and dishes, creating, updating, and deleting meals and dishes, as well as creating dishes from recipes. The controller interacts with models and the database to perform CRUD operations and constructs URLs for AJAX responses.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Ajax::MealsDishesEditor
classes.description: Catalyst controller handling AJAX requests for managing meals and dishes within a project, including CRUD operations and moving items.

methods.name: get_project_plan
methods.description: Retrieves the project plan with meals and dishes, constructing URLs for each item for AJAX interactions.

methods.name: get_recipes
methods.description: Returns a list of recipes via AJAX, including a URL to fetch all recipes.

methods.name: move_meal_or_dish
methods.description: Handles moving a meal or dish before or after another item, with validation and URL updates.

methods.name: delete_dishes_from_meal
methods.description: Deletes all dishes from a specified meal.

methods.name: create_meal
methods.description: Creates a new meal with specified date, name, and comment.

methods.name: update_meal
methods.description: Updates an existing meal's date, name, and comment, with validation for duplicate names on the same date.

methods.name: delete_meal
methods.description: Deletes a meal if it is deletable.

methods.name: create_dish
methods.description: Creates a new dish within a specified meal.

methods.name: create_dish_from_recipe
methods.description: Creates a new dish based on an existing recipe within a specified meal.
